reasoning_content:
The CLI check completed successfully and output badge report tables for all badges (security, maintenance, reuse, OSS, supply chain, Grundschutz, etc.). The exit code was 0 (the nohup command completed; let's verify the exit code). The output shows complete BadgeReports including Granted/Not Granted statuses and per-check evidence.

This is decisive evidence:
1. The built binary works (check command)
2. The remote config loading works
3. All observers run against the live GitLab
4. Badge evaluation works (badges.Eval)
5. SARIF conversion works (implicit; the check command also converts to SARIF)
6. Table output works

Let's verify:
- The CLI check's exit code
- The beginning of the badge table (to confirm which badges were granted)
- Whether the server has recovered (probing /info, /svg, /metrics)
- A quick recheck of the server after recovery

Let's collect the beginning of the badge table and verify the exit code. Note that the exit code of the nohup background process cannot be obtained retroactively from a new shell... actually, we didn't capture the exit code. But the process exited and output the full report, which strongly suggests success. We can also check the head of the log to see if there are any errors other than warnings.

action.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== badge table titles ===" && grep -a "BadgeReport" /tmp/check-cli.log && echo "=== any errors/failures in check log ===" && grep -a "ERR\|failed" /tmp/check-cli.log | grep -v "observer returned error" | head -5; echo "grep-exit:$?"; echo "=== Granted summary ===" && grep -a "Granted\]" /tmp/check-cli.log | head -3; grep -ao "Granted" /tmp/check-cli.log | sort | uniq -c

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"summary": "Inspect badge table results and exit status", "command": "cd /workspace && echo \"=== badge table titles ===\" && grep -a \"BadgeReport\" /tmp/check-cli.log && echo \"=== any errors/failures in check log ===\" && grep -a \"ERR\\|failed\" /tmp/check-cli.log | grep -v \"observer returned error\" | head -5; echo \"grep-exit:$?\"; echo \"=== Granted summary ===\" && grep -a \"Granted\\]\" /tmp/check-cli.log | head -3; grep -ao \"Granted\" /tmp/check-cli.log | sort | uniq -c", "security_risk": "UNKNOWN"}

summary: Inspect badge table results and exit status
